change.finding: Previously, a historical dating window extending from birth to World start inherited the recency of its newest endpoint.
change.policy: Average the existing 30-day recency curve with its 500 floor uniformly over the historical date window. The uniform prior is an accessibility heuristic, not a factual date estimate.
boundaries: Recorded runtime activity intervals still use their observed end.
Source text, dates, ownership, privacy, authority and query time filters are unchanged.
The index version changes; source event and historical receipt formats do not.
